import json

# Extract the JSON from stdout
lines = compat_script_out.split("\n")
stdout_line_idx = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.startswith("STDOUT:"):
        stdout_line_idx = i
        break

if stdout_line_idx is not None:
    # Get everything after "STDOUT: " up to "STDERR:"
    stdout_text = ""
    for line in lines[stdout_line_idx:]:
        if line.startswith("STDERR:"):
            break
        stdout_text += line + "\n"
    stdout_text = stdout_text.replace("STDOUT:", "", 1).strip()
    if stdout_text:
        parsed = json.loads(stdout_text)
        print(json.dumps(parsed, indent=2))
    else:
        print("No stdout JSON found")
        print("Full output:", compat_script_out)
